# temporal binding effect

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(rprojroot)

proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file_pattern("\\.Rproj$"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
```

## load data

```{r}
source("analysis/01_temporal_binding_effect/temporal_binding_effect_utils.R")

# ---------- paths ----------
dir_pdf <- "figures/01_temporal_binding_effect"
dir_res <- "results/01_temporal_binding_effect"

ensure_dir(dir_pdf)
ensure_dir(dir_res)

# ---------- load processed data used in paper ----------
perceptual_shift_action_outcome <- read_csv(
  "data/01_temporal_binding_effect/perceptual_shift_action_outcome.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
)
```

## Plot raw perceptual shift

```{r}
df_action <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_action_outcome,
  cols = c("va_ba", "ia_bi"),
  levels = c("va_ba", "ia_bi"),
  labels = c("Voluntary", "Involuntary")
)

df_outcome <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_action_outcome,
  cols = c("vs_bs", "is_bs"),
  levels = c("vs_bs", "is_bs"),
  labels = c("Voluntary", "Involuntary")
)

# palettes
pal_action <- c("#006AB6", "#F28E2B")
pal_outcome <- c("#59A14F", "#F28498")

p_action <- plot_halfviolin(
  df_action,
  title = "Action",
  y_breaks = seq(-150, 150, 50),
  palette = pal_action
)

p_outcome <- plot_halfviolin(
  df_outcome,
  title = "Sound",
  y_breaks = seq(-400, 0, 50),
  palette = pal_outcome
)

p_action
p_outcome

save_plot_pdf(
  p_action,
  stem = "action_binding",
  dir_pdf = dir_pdf
)

save_plot_pdf(
  p_outcome,
  stem = "outcome_binding",
  dir_pdf = dir_pdf
)
```


## Condition comparisons

```{r}
tests_one_sample_full <- bind_rows(
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome$va_ba,
    "Action: Voluntary vs 0",
    alternative = "greater"
  ),
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome$ia_bi,
    "Action: Involuntary vs 0",
    alternative = "greater"
  ),
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome$vs_bs,
    "Outcome: Voluntary vs 0",
    alternative = "less"
  ),
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome$is_bs,
    "Outcome: Involuntary vs 0",
    alternative = "less"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(analysis = "Full sample")


outlier_id <- flag_outliers_2sd(perceptual_shift_action_outcome$va_ba)

perceptual_shift_action_outcome_no_outlier <- perceptual_shift_action_outcome %>%
  filter(!outlier_id)

tests_one_sample_no_outlier <- bind_rows(
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome_no_outlier$va_ba,
    "Action: Voluntary vs 0",
    alternative = "greater"
  ),
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome_no_outlier$vs_bs,
    "Outcome: Voluntary vs 0",
    alternative = "less"
  ),
  one_sample_wilcox(
    perceptual_shift_action_outcome_no_outlier$is_bs,
    "Outcome: Involuntary vs 0",
    alternative = "less"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(analysis = "After outlier removal")

tests_one_sample <- bind_rows(
  tests_one_sample_full,
  tests_one_sample_no_outlier
) %>%
  select(
    analysis,
    test,
    n,
    alternative,
    w_stat,
    w_p,
    w_p_print
  )

write_csv(
  tests_one_sample,
  file.path(dir_res, "one_sample_tests.csv")
)

tests_one_sample

```
